notes: The Layered edition is now built into PRO: any block can draw as a shaded zone and start with Block 1, and the layered layout is the new default.
changelog: Each block can now draw as lines with Fibonacci levels or as a shaded zone, and Blocks 2 to 4 can start with Block 1 for a nested, layered view
New default layout: Blocks 2 and 3 show as 30 and 15 minute zones inside the Block 1 IB. Saved charts with Block 2 or 3 on will now show them as zones; set Style to 0 to switch back
Fixed IBs that end at or after midnight never completing
Fixed session-anchored IBs resetting on the last bar of the session
The IB rectangle no longer draws a solid border around its shaded fill
New Max History setting limits how many past days are drawn, for faster charts
